cells.gaps: The only statement of absence is UNECA's of 2009-04, more than seventeen years before the as-at; nothing later confirms or contradicts it. Nothing is held on governance, finance or the last twelve months.
cells.note: No ICT sector policy: a dated UNECA statement (2009-04) says Eritrea has no national ICT policy, none is on record as adopted or in preparation, and no national digital strategy has been found. Stage 2 needs a policy at least announced, and no row shows one.
